wrong.why: The verse names Ezra's father as Seraiah son of Azariah, which is the record seraiah-11 (distinguished as Ezra's father); seraiah-2 is a different record, the chief priest of 2KI 25:18, that the chapter does not tie to Ezra.
The Seraiah who fathers Ezra in this verse is seraiah-11, which already holds this relation (row 103739); the chapter does not identify seraiah-2 as Ezra's father.
The Seraiah son of Azariah in this verse is seraiah-11, already recorded as son of azariah-7 (row 103740); seraiah-2 is not tied to this verse.
The Azariah of this verse has a son Seraiah who is Ezra's father, which is seraiah-11, not seraiah-2 (the chief priest of 2KI 25:18).
The Azariah of this verse is the son of Meraioth and father of Amariah, which is azariah-24 (already recorded as row 103627); azariah, son of Johanan, is a different man.
Meraioth's son named in this verse is azariah-24 (Ezra's genealogy), not azariah, son of Johanan.

note: Either seraiah-2 and seraiah-11 are one man (then the first four items fall away and the pair is a merge question for the owner) or they are not (then these items stand).
